title.en: AI Coding Brief: Gemini 4 Carbon lands in GitHub Copilot

description.en: A quiet day for Claude Code, Codex, GPT and Gemini Code Assist themselves, but GitHub Copilot picks up Google's new Gemini 4 Carbon as a selectable model — and Qwen 4 and Kimi K3.1 Pro's open weights are still the ones to watch this week.

text.en: GitHub Copilot adds Gemini 4 Carbon as a model
Claude Code, Codex, GPT, Gemini Code Assist: no new releases today
Kimi K3.1 Pro's promised open weights still haven't shipped

title.en: Gemini 4 Carbon arrives in GitHub Copilot

body_html.en: GitHub Copilot adds Google's Gemini 4 Carbon as a selectable model, days after Google began rolling the frontier coding/cybersecurity model out to early-access partners.

notes.en: Still no official model card; Alibaba's only confirmed detail remains the Max/Plus/Flash lineup plus a 27B open-weight model previewed back in September.
The 3T-parameter, 1M-context model shipped in late October, but the full open-weight release Moonshot promised for Nov 4 still hasn't appeared.

notable_trends.en: The US coding-assistant race paused for a day — no dated releases from Claude Code, Codex CLI, GPT, or Gemini Code Assist since yesterday's brief — while GitHub Copilot kept adding third-party models, this time Google's Gemini 4 Carbon.

Both pending Chinese-lab releases on the radar, Qwen 4 and Kimi K3.1 Pro's open weights, have now slipped past their own teased windows at least once, so this week's model story is still mostly a waiting game.
